(let step
  (lambda n
    (lambda c
      (if (eq n 1)
          c
          (if (mod n 2)
              (step (merge (mul 3 n) 1) (merge c 1))
              (step (div n 2) (merge c 1))))))
  (step 27 0))

(let fib
  (lambda a
    (lambda b
      (lambda k
        (if (eq k 0)
            a
            (fib b (merge a b) (sub k 1))))))
  (fib 0 1 25))

(fold (lambda a (lambda x (merge a x)))
      0
      (filter (lambda n (eq (tau n) 2))
              (range 2 100)))

(let go
  (lambda t
    (lambda prev
      (lambda cur
        (lambda best
          (if (nil? t)
              (if (gt cur best) cur best)
              (let c (head t)
                (let ncur (if (eq c prev) (merge cur 1) 1)
                  (go (tail t)
                      c
                      ncur
                      (if (gt ncur best) ncur best)))))))))
  (go "aaabbbbcca" (neg 1) 0 0))
